description: The friendly message shown when a cmux command fails, per command result kind, in this order: (1) spawn failure: '<action> failed to start: <stderr condensed to 160>' or '<action> failed to start.'; (2) timeout: '<action> timed out — is the cmux app running?'; otherwise the detail is stderr condensed to 200, or stdout condensed to 200 when stderr is blank; (3) a detail saying the control socket was not found means cmux is not running: '<action> failed — cmux isn’t running. Open the cmux app, then try again.'; (4) a detail mentioning socket, broken pipe or permission (case-insensitive) is cmux's cmuxOnly socket mode refusing PowerUp: the fixed Automation-settings advice; (5) '<action> failed: <detail>'; (6) no detail: '<action> failed (exit <status>).'. Condensing follows condense.json. Typographic quotes and dashes are part of the text.
function: RemoteControlService.failureMessage(action:result:) — input {action, status, standardOutput, standardError, timedOut, spawnFailed} (the action label plus every CommandResult field) in, message string out
verifiedBy: Characterization of the Swift implementation (spec #93, ticket #121); Tests/PowerUpTests/CmuxReportingFixtureTests.swift. The socket-not-found stderr and exit status were captured live from `cmux ping` with the cmux app closed (read-only command).
capturedAgainst: cmux 0.64.17 (97) [9ed29d81a]; PowerUp macOS app, branch stage-1-text-views-spikes, 2026-10-23

cases.name: spawn failure with detail
cases.expected: Reaching cmux failed to start: The file “cmux” doesn’t exist.
cases.reason: The binary could not be launched; the system's reason is passed on so the person can fix the path.

cases.name: spawn failure without detail
cases.expected: Reaching cmux failed to start.
cases.reason: No reason available must still produce a full sentence, not a dangling colon.

cases.name: spawn failure detail is condensed to 160
cases.expected: Sending text to cmux failed to start: line one line two zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz…
cases.reason: A long multi-line launch error is flattened and cut so the status line stays one readable line.

cases.name: spawn failure wins over timeout
cases.expected: Reaching cmux failed to start: launch path not accessible
cases.reason: A process that never started cannot have timed out; the launch failure is the real cause.

cases.name: spawn failure is not translated into the socket advice

input.standardError: You don’t have permission to open cmux.

cases.expected: Reaching cmux failed to start: You don’t have permission to open cmux.
cases.reason: A launch permission problem is not a cmux socket-mode problem; the socket advice would mislead.

cases.name: timeout
cases.expected: Listing cmux workspaces timed out — is the cmux app running?
cases.reason: A hung cmux call points the person at the app, the usual cause.

cases.name: timeout ignores partial stderr
cases.expected: Pressing Enter in cmux timed out — is the cmux app running?
cases.reason: Whatever a killed process managed to print is not the reason it was killed.

cases.name: cmux not running: socket not found
cases.expected: Reaching cmux failed — cmux isn’t running. Open the cmux app, then try again.
cases.reason: Captured live from cmux 0.64.17 with the app closed: stderr 'Error: Socket not found at …/cmux.sock', exit 1. The person must be told to open cmux, not sent to change socket settings that are fine.

cases.name: cmux not running names the action
cases.expected: Sending text to cmux failed — cmux isn’t running. Open the cmux app, then try again.
cases.reason: The message names which step failed, like every other failure message.

cases.name: socket refusal: broken pipe
cases.expected: cmux refused the connection. In cmux, open Settings → Automation, set “Socket control mode” to Password (or Automation), then quit and reopen cmux. For Password mode, put the same password in PowerUp’s Remote settings.
cases.reason: cmux's default cmuxOnly socket mode drops a foreign app with a broken pipe; the person needs the one-time Automation setting.

cases.name: socket refusal: socket write error
cases.expected: cmux refused the connection. In cmux, open Settings → Automation, set “Socket control mode” to Password (or Automation), then quit and reopen cmux. For Password mode, put the same password in PowerUp’s Remote settings.
cases.reason: Any other socket error from a running cmux is the same refusal.

cases.name: socket refusal: permission denied
cases.expected: cmux refused the connection. In cmux, open Settings → Automation, set “Socket control mode” to Password (or Automation), then quit and reopen cmux. For Password mode, put the same password in PowerUp’s Remote settings.
cases.reason: A wrong or missing socket password surfaces as a permission error; same fix.

cases.name: socket refusal matched case-insensitively
cases.expected: cmux refused the connection. In cmux, open Settings → Automation, set “Socket control mode” to Password (or Automation), then quit and reopen cmux. For Password mode, put the same password in PowerUp’s Remote settings.
cases.reason: The match ignores case so a reworded cmux error still gets the advice.

cases.name: socket refusal found in stdout fallback
cases.expected: cmux refused the connection. In cmux, open Settings → Automation, set “Socket control mode” to Password (or Automation), then quit and reopen cmux. For Password mode, put the same password in PowerUp’s Remote settings.
cases.reason: Some cmux builds print errors on stdout; the translation applies to whichever stream carried the detail.

cases.name: non-zero exit with stderr
cases.expected: Sending text to cmux failed: Error: workspace not found: workspace:99
cases.reason: cmux's own reason is shown after the action, trimmed to one line.

cases.name: stderr wins over stdout
cases.expected: Pressing Enter in cmux failed: Error: no such surface
cases.reason: stderr is the error channel; stdout is only a fallback.

cases.name: stdout fallback when stderr is empty
cases.expected: Sending Escape to cmux failed: Error: unknown key
cases.reason: When cmux reports on stdout the person still gets the reason.

cases.name: stdout fallback when stderr is only whitespace
cases.expected: Sending Escape to cmux failed: unknown key
cases.reason: Whitespace-only stderr is no detail; condensing it to empty triggers the fallback.

cases.name: multi-line stderr is condensed to one line

input.standardError:
Error: bad request
  hint: update cmux

cases.expected: Listing cmux workspaces failed: Error: bad request hint: update cmux
cases.reason: The status line is one line; newlines would break the layout.

cases.name: long stderr is cut at 200 characters
cases.expected: Listing cmux workspaces failed: EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE…
cases.reason: A runaway error dump is shortened with a visible marker.

cases.name: no detail at all
cases.expected: Pressing Enter in cmux failed (exit 2).
cases.reason: With nothing printed, the exit status is the only clue; the sentence stays complete.

cases.name: no detail with negative status
cases.expected: Sending text to cmux failed (exit -1).
cases.reason: A process still running at the deadline reports -1; whitespace-only output counts as no detail.
